full_judgment:
9. Mr. M. Quamrul Haque Siddique, by placing the plaint submitted that in the plaint clear averment having been made that out of 2.90 acres land from C.S. plot No.210 of C.S. khatian No.215, the Government acquired 2.20 acres land and 70 decimals land remained unacquired of which the plaintiffs were the owners, but the Housing Authority illegally created a plot out of the unacquired land as described in schedule 'kha' to the plaint and allotted the same to defendant No.9 and that illegal action of the Housing Authority gave cause of action to the plaintiffs to file the instant suit, the question of the suit being barred either under the provisions of the Emergency Requisition of property Act, 1948 or the Ordinance, 1982 does not arise at all. 

 13. From a reading of the plaint, it appears that the plaintiffs made categorical statements therein that out of 2.90 acres land of C.S. plot No.210, appertaining to C.S. khatian No.215, 2.20 acres land were acquired in L/A Case Nos. 13/59-62 and 70 decimals land remained unacquired which was described in schedule 'ka' to the plaint. In the plaint it was also stated that out of 70 decimals unacquired land as described in schedule 'ka' to the plaint, defendant Nos.1-4 created a 10 katas Industrial plot illegally being plot No. D/18-D and handed over the same to defendant No.9 as shown in the red ink in the naksha attached to the plaint. It was further stated that defendant Nos.9-14 illegally occupied 2659 Agutangsha land or more or less 16 kathas land out of unacquired 70 decimals land. From the plaint and the prayers made in the plaint it is crystal clear that the plaintiffs did not make any claim to any portion of the acquired land. Whether defendant Nos.1-4 created any plot out of the unacquired land and handed over the possession thereof to defendant No.9 is purely a question of fact and that can only be decided after thrashing out the evidence to be adduced by the parties at the peremptory hearing of the suit. It is also a very significant fact that before filing the application for rejection of the plaint a local investigation had already been held to ascertain the position of the pillar demarcating the Government and the non Government land. Further from the written statement filed by the defendant Nos.1-5 it appears that they admitted the fact that out of 2.90 acres land of the C.S. plot in question the Government acquired 2.20 acres land only. 

 "The learned Advocate for the defendant no. I has submitted supplementary affidavit on 14.06.2012 annexing attested photo copy of the proposed acquisition boundary line drawn up on the C.S. map by the requiring body, accepted acquisition line drawn up on the C.S, map by the Land Acquisition Authority along with corresponding to R.S. map, City operation map, et. it transpires that there is no devotion in the line of original acquisition map with the present position and that the specific area of non-requisitioned land of Plot no. 210 remains untouched as before since the time of acquisition in the years 1960-61, By annexure-Q, Engineering section of the National Housing Authority also prepared sketch map showing the area of the acquired land which is exactly the same with the original acquisition map. Annexure-N is the latest City Survey Khatian No.3 prepared in the name of Housing settlement Authority and no objection has been raised in the suit by the plaintiffs against the last Khatian. Annexure-D of the Supplementary affidavit dated 21.05.2012 stands to show that the gazette notification under section 5(7) of the Emergency Requisition of Property Act, 1948 was published in the official gazette on 18.12.1980. At the initial stage of the acquisition proceeding, physical survey of the land proposed to the acquired was conducted and sketch map of the proposed acquired area was obviously drawn up and the said accepted acquisition map is essentially a part and parcel of the land acquisition proceeding. The plaintiffs appear to have prayed for correction of the said acquisition map of the L.A. Case No.159/60-61, which is the most vital part of the acquisition process. Moreover, the sketch map of the L.A. Case showing boundary of the acquired land was prepared long before at the time of initiation of the L.A proceedings on the basis of the said acquisition map, acquisition notice was published in the official gazette on 18,12.1980. Prior to that date, possession was taken over by the requisitioning authority on the basis of sketch map shown as acquired area of land and handed it over to the requiring body i.e. National Housing Authority. The owners found in position of the acquired land at the relevant time, had admittedly received compensation. It appears from Annexure (Annexure)- H series of the supplementary-affidavit dated 13.6.2012 that the defendant no.9 applied for allotment of industrial plot, and national Housing Authority decided to give allotment of D/18-D in favour of M/S. Ing. Ming International Ltd. in February, 1995. Other Annexure clearly show that after allotment, delivery of possession was given to the allottee defendant no.9 on 5.6.1995 on payment of consideration money by different chalans, a lease deed was executed and registered on 28.6.1995 vide Annexure-F-2 of the Supplementary -Affidavit dated 21.05.2012. So the series of reliable official documents of the government show that all acts regarding allotment of industrial Plot no.D-8, Block-D were completed in the year 1995. But the plaintiff filed the suit long after in the year 2006 seeking declaration that the registered lease deed executed in favour of the defendant no.9 is illegal and void, and alleging further that the said industrial plot was given in possession of defendant no.9 on 10.7.2006, which is against the series of official records and as such unbelievable. It is simple an absurd proposition that after making delivery of possession in the year 1995 on the basis of a registered instrument, chalans and allotment letters, the defendant nos.1-4 again come to give delivery of possession to the defendant no.9 in the year 2006. So the alleged cause of action as stated in the plaint is apparently unreliable."
